lines.zh: 我跟着科学家，走在他侧后。
lines.en: I walk behind the scientist at his flank.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩在碎砖上，很响。
lines.en: My boots crunch on broken brick.

lines.zh: 我沿着这条路慢慢巡查。
lines.en: I work my way along this road.
I check the windows as I go.
I head for that building.
I go around the broken glass.
My hand rests at my hip.

lines.zh: 我走几步就回头看一眼。
lines.en: Every few steps I glance back.

lines.zh: 我顺着有哭声的方向走。
lines.en: I follow the sound of crying.
I walk a stretch along the tire ruts.

lines.zh: 我把脚步放轻，靠近转角。
lines.en: I soften my steps at the corner.
I signal to my squadmate.
I move slowly across the street.
I keep to the middle of the column.

lines.zh: 我站着，手一直没离开腰侧。
lines.en: I stand with my hand never off my hip.
I am watching that row of windows.

lines.zh: 我把面罩抬起来一点透气。
lines.en: I lift my visor a little for air.
I listen without a sound.
I nudge the loose stones clear.
I wait for the scientist to speak.
I tug my gloves straight.
I turn my head slowly.
I put my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有爬动的声音。
lines.en: I listen for anything crawling.
I lower my gaze to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在面罩里很稳。
lines.en: My breathing in the visor is steady.
I stand rigid as a signboard.

lines.zh: 我在数附近还有几栋完好的房子。
lines.en: I am counting the houses still intact.

lines.zh: 我把面罩转过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn my visor to face you.
Hold still and let me see you.

lines.zh: 你在我的视线里，是安全的。
lines.en: You are in my sight, which is safe.
Do you have any wounds?
I look you over, foot to hand.
I do not stop ordinary people.
What brings you near this zone?
I take my hand off my hip.

lines.zh: 这里随时会有东西出来。
lines.en: Something can come out here at any moment.

lines.zh: 我上前半步，挡在你前面。
lines.en: I step half a pace and stand before you.

lines.zh: 你要往那边走，我劝你别去。
lines.en: If you mean to go that way, I advise against it.
You are not trembling, good.
I nod to you once.
I wait for you to finish.
My visor catches the light.

lines.zh: 要不要跟着我们走一段？
lines.en: Would you walk with us a stretch?
I take a step and my armor dents.
I swallow that blow in silence.
I press the wound and steady.
A crack appears on my visor.
I grit my teeth and swallow the blood.
My breath has grown heavy.

lines.zh: 我把身体横在科学家前面。
lines.en: I put my body across in front of the scientist.
That goes into my logbook.
My legs still hold me.
I set my hand back in place.
I put none of that in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我先查你的手。
lines.en: You hold it up and I check your hands first.
Save that for the others.
I will not take it.
Set it down and I will deal with it.
That is not on my list.
I turn my head the other way.
I step around your hand.
Keep it for yourself.
I gesture for you to step back.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，我退了一步。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I give a step.
I steady you.
Do not run; hitting me will hurt you.
I shift half a step to let you by.
This gear strikes hard.
I raise my forearm to block.
I look down without speaking.
Steady; let me help you up.
You have come too near.
I back up to the wall.
I am standing guard.
We will speak of that later.
I turn my visor aside.
The squad does not allow it.
I put my hand back at my hip.
I step back to my old place.

lines.zh: 这会儿不是说这个的时候。
lines.en: Now is not the moment for it.
I go back to watching ahead.
Wait until this wave passes.
I take one step back.
I bend and pick up a roll of bandage.
I stow it in my belt pouch.
This must not be touched bare-handed.
I lift it with my pliers.
I seal the sample.
This can still be used.
I set it back where it was.

lines.zh: 我检查了一下有没有破口。
lines.en: I check it for a breach.
I hand it to the scientist.
I brush the dust off my hands.
Something shifts behind the wall.
I signal for silence.
I have marked it red.
Its posture is not right.
I push the scientist back.

lines.zh: 我朝那边走近，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I close in with light steps.
It has mutated.
I see how tall it is.
It is stuck in the door frame.
I circle round its flank.

lines.zh: 我跟着它挪，一直挡在前面。
lines.en: I shift with it, always in front.
It wheels about and I wheel with it.
I keep the scientist behind me.
It lunges and I turn aside.
I count its movements silently.
It backs off and I halt.
I wait for my squadmate to get into place.
It is already changing shape.
My hand sits on my strap buckle.
It aims to slip round the right.
My fist lands on its chest.
I shoulder it aside.
I kick it into the wall.
That one hits its joint.
It claws me and the armor holds.
I add a second punch.

lines.zh: 我把它按住，回头看科学家。
lines.en: I pin it and glance back at the scientist.
It backs off and I stand in front.
My glove has worn through.
I shove it back into the alley.

lines.zh: 我从街口走进来，先看两侧。
lines.en: I come in from the street, checking both sides.
The scientist is behind me.
I check my armor and visor.
This stretch has not been cleared.
I raise a hand to halt.
The wind carries a smell of blood.
I plant myself in the middle of the street.

lines.zh: 我把面罩抬高看了一眼。
lines.en: I lift my visor to look.
The bricks are all loose.
I pick a route with good sightlines.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的护甲，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my armor and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 落地时双膝砸下去，我扛住了。
lines.en: Both knees slam down on landing and I bear it.
Water seeps into my visor and I jerk up.

lines.zh: 炸风把我推得撞在车上。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a vehicle.

lines.zh: 护甲里嵌了东西，我拔掉。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my armor and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我，我一时动不了。
lines.en: An art binds me and I cannot move for a moment.

lines.zh: 太久没换班，我的腿发软。
lines.en: Too long on duty and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的装备淌，手臂发木。
lines.en: Lightning runs my kit and my arm goes wooden.

lines.zh: 脚下没有砖，我一路坠下。
lines.en: No brick below and I fall away.
